source_cases.label: GLOBAL_FROM_NAMESPACE
source_cases.script: set ::done 0; namespace eval N {variable x LOCAL; after 0 {set x GLOBAL; set ::done 1}; vwait ::done; list $x $::x}

source_cases.label: GLOBAL_FROM_PROC
source_cases.script: set ::x OLD; proc p {} {set x LOCAL; after 0 {set x NEW}; vwait x; list $x $::x}; p

source_cases.label: SAME_WRITE
source_cases.script: set x SAME; set log {}; after 0 {set x SAME; lappend log SAME}; after 0 {set x NEXT; lappend log NEXT}; vwait x; set log

source_cases.label: ARRAY_SAME_WRITE
source_cases.script: array set a {k OLD}; after 0 {set a(k) OLD}; after 0 {set a(k) NEW}; vwait a(k); set a(k)

source_cases.label: UNSET_WRITE
source_cases.script: set x OLD; after 0 {unset x}; vwait x; info exists x

source_cases.label: CONCAT_TRIM
source_cases.script: set done 0; after 0 { set} { done } {1 }; vwait done; set done

source_cases.label: PURE_LIST_SCRIPT
source_cases.script: set done 0; set body [list set done {A B}]; after 0 $body; vwait done; set done

source_cases.label: CANCEL_COUNTED
source_cases.script: set done 0; after 0 {set done 1}; after cancel {set done 1}; update; set done

source_cases.label: CANCEL_CONCAT
source_cases.script: set done 0; after 0 {set done 1}; after cancel { set} { done 1 }; update; set done

source_cases.label: INFO_SCRIPT
source_cases.script: set id [after idle {set done 1}]; lindex [after info $id] 0

source_cases.label: UPDATE_IDLE
source_cases.script: set x OLD; after 0 {set x TIMER}; after idle {set x IDLE}; update idletasks; set x

source_cases.label: DELAY_NO_EVENTS
source_cases.script: set x OLD; after 0 {set x TIMER}; after 1; set x

source_cases.label: PREFIX_BGERROR
source_cases.script: set done 0; proc handler {prefix message} {set ::done [list $prefix $message]}; interp bgerror {} [list handler PRE]; after 0 {error BOOM}; vwait done; set done
